reviews.body:
**No issues found** across 6 files
Architecture diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant WF as n8n Workflow participant Node as AWS Node (S3/Textract/Transcribe) participant Cred as AWS Credentials participant Validator as assertSupportedAwsRegion() participant Signer as AWS V4 Signer participant AWS as AWS Service Endpoint WF->>Node: Execute node with credential reference Node->>Cred: Read AWS credentials (region, keys) Cred-->>Node: Credential object (region, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey) Note over Node,AWS: Region validation gate Node->>Validator: Call with region string alt Valid AWS region (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1) Validator-->>Node: Pass (no throw) Node->>Signer: Build signed request with region Signer->>AWS: HTTPS request to {service}.{region}.amazonaws.com AWS-->>Signer: Response Signer-->>Node: Parsed response Node-->>WF: Result else Invalid region (e.g., @example.com#, us-fake-1, empty) Validator-->>Node: Throw ApplicationError("Unsupported AWS region") Node-->>WF: NodeApiError (no request sent) end Note over Node,AWS: Also applied in assumeRole (STS) flow Node->>Validator: assertSupportedAwsRegion(region) alt Valid region Node->>Signer: Sign STS AssumeRole request Signer->>AWS: sts.amazonaws.com call AWS-->>Signer: Temporary credentials Signer-->>Node: Role session keys else Invalid region Node-->>WF: Error before any sign/network call end Note over Validator: Region set built from supported regions list
Case-sensitive, exact match required
Rejects SSRF-like values (IPs, hosts, special chars) ```
